title: DNA quantification using the Qubit fluorometer
author: Kirstyn Brunker
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc6vize6
materials: The instrument displays the results on the Read standard screen. For information on interpreting the calibration results, refer to the Qubit™ Fluorometer User Guide, available for download at thermofisher.com/qubit.

steps.title: Label tubes and select type
steps.instruction: Label only the lids of thin‑wall, clear 0.5 mL PCR tubes (acceptable: Qubit™ assay tubes, Cat. No. Q32856) and do not label the side of the tube.

steps.title: Prepare Qubit working mastermix
steps.instruction: Prepare a Qubit™ working solution mastermix for the total number of samples plus two standards. For each sample use 1 µL Qubit® dsDNA HS Reagent and 199 µL Qubit® dsDNA HS Buffer. Remove the total required volume from the working‑solution bottle before dispensing to avoid cross‑contamination. Perform a new calibration for each batch (or same‑day calibration) unless a suitable previous calibration is already stored on the instrument.

steps.title: Aliquot working solution to tubes
steps.instruction: Add 190 µL of the prepared working solution to each standard tube. Add 180–199 µL of working solution to each sample tube so that the final volume will be 200 µL after sample/standard addition.

steps.title: Add standards or samples
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of each dsDNA HS standard to the appropriate standard tube. Add 1–20 µL of each user sample to the corresponding sample tube; use a P‑2 pipette for volumes of 1–2 µL.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL standard to each standard tube.
Add 1–20 µL sample to each sample tube (use P‑2 pipette for 1–2 µL).

steps.title: Vortex mix tubes
steps.instruction: Vigorously vortex each tube for 3–5 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate tubes
steps.instruction: Allow all tubes to incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Set up Qubit instrument
steps.instruction: On the Qubit™ 3 Fluorometer Home screen, press DNA, select 1X dsDNA HS assay, and press Read Standards. If a calibration already exists, choose to use the previous calibration; otherwise perform a new calibration as recommended.

substeps.instruction: Select DNA assay and 1X dsDNA HS.
Choose new calibration or use previous calibration as appropriate.

steps.title: Read Standard #1
steps.instruction: Insert the tube containing Standard #1 into the sample chamber, close the lid, press Read Standard, wait ~3 seconds, then remove the tube.

steps.title: Read Standard #2
steps.instruction: Insert the tube containing Standard #2 into the sample chamber, close the lid, press Read Standard, wait for the reading to complete, then remove the tube.

steps.title: Run sample measurements
steps.instruction: Press Run Samples on the instrument.

steps.title: Select sample volume and units
steps.instruction: On the assay screen, use the wheel to set the sample volume added to the assay tube (1–20 µL) and select ng/µL as the output unit from the dropdown menu.

steps.title: Read each sample tube
steps.instruction: For each sample, insert its tube into the sample chamber, close the lid, press Read tube, wait ~3 seconds, then remove the tube. Repeat for all samples.

steps.title: Record results and save file
steps.instruction: Carefully record all concentration results and store the run file from the Qubit on a memory stick.

steps.title: Check negative controls
steps.instruction: Verify that all negative controls read ‘too low’ (ideally 0 ng/µL). If any control is ≥1 ng/µL, consider the run contaminated and repeat the procedure from the appropriate step.
